title: MPS calculator: approve what goes onto the hosted site with the home dashboard
bluf: Kam: open the attached pack (screenshots + new words) and tap a, b or c. The next hosted deploy ships four merged rounds, not just the Home dashboard and Won/Lost recording (#28): the quote audit (#25), its fix round (#26) and the price-book version groundwork (#27, switched off on hosted) ride along, adding 27 strings you have not approved (W-01 to W-27; 10 can show on a screen). Recorded Won/Lost outcomes are lost if the site is ever rolled back to an older build.

options.label: Approve the screenshots and all the listed words; deploy now
options.detail: A deploy seat ships main (after PR #28 merges) to the same hosted link, code only; Friday runs the gates' pre- and post-deploy checks and tells you the result.

options.label: Deploy, but reword the IDs I name in a note in a follow-up
options.detail: The deploy goes ahead as built; name the W-IDs and your wording in the note, and a small seat changes them through a QA gate afterwards.

options.label: Hold the deploy
options.detail: The hosted site stays on db8edfd until you say otherwise.

default_action: The hosted deploy waits for your tap; nothing on the hosted site changes until then.
